Hi Alex — great to hear from you and thanks for sharing the checklist. We can definitely run a focused session covering SSO, audit logs, retention/export paths, and our encryption (KMS integration and key rotation).

Suggested 60-minute agenda:
1) 10m — introductions + scope (what evidence you need vs nice-to-have)
2) 20m — SSO: supported protocols, IdP metadata, session handling, and how SSO-related evidence is surfaced in logs
3) 15m — Audit logs: what we capture, retention options, export/delivery (S3/Logstash), access controls
4) 10m — Encryption & key management (at-rest, in-transit, KMS options)
5) 5m — next steps / evidence handoff and playbook

From Redwood: myself (solutions), Ben Carter (customer success), and Marissa Cole (security engineering) will join. I attached a short outline of our architecture and the artifacts we typically provide.

Available from our side: Tue Aug 17 10:00 ET and Thu Aug 19 15:00 ET work. Wed 14:00 ET conflicts for Marissa.

If you can confirm preferred slot I will send a calendar invite and upload the pre-reads to the shared drive. Also: can you confirm whether your auditors need signed attestations or just exported artifacts? That will affect what we prepare.
